description: Experiment 15 re-analyzes the published Known-ODE runs on degraded Flyvis-217 data with the paper's current analysis code, applying model noise, measurement noise, and added/removed connectivity edges. Evaluation uses five-fold cross-validation (mean ± SD), with prediction metrics computed on noise-free data using held-out stimuli of 7,207–7,999 frames per fold. Parameter recovery reports R2 for W via the template readout, R2 for tau and V_rest over all neurons with outlier correction, and GMM clustering accuracy over 65 cell types.
facts:
CAPTION: Known-ODE evaluation across degraded versions of the Flyvis training data: model and measurement noise, added/removed connectivity edges. The published Known-ODE runs, re-analysed with the paper’s current analysis code (experiment 15). Five-fold cross-validation (mean ± SD). Prediction: metrics computed on noise-free data with held-out stimuli (7,207–7,999 frames by fold). Parameter recovery: R2 ˆ W by the template readout over the fitted edges, as for the GNN rows; R2 ˆτ and R2 ˆV rest over all neurons, outlier-corrected (outlier fraction in parentheses, Appendix I); GMM clustering accuracy over 65 cell types. Green: value > 0.9. Orange: value < 0.3.
FACTS:
- model noise: experiment 15: Known ODE re-analysed on degraded Flyvis-217 data
- measurement noise: experiment 15: Known ODE re-analysed on degraded Flyvis-217 data
- edges: experiment 15: Known ODE re-analysed on degraded Flyvis-217 data
GLOSSARY (meaning of identifier fragments; use only these):
- blank50: in every video clip of the stimulus, the first 50% of the frames are replaced by blank frames
- cv00 .. cv04: cross-validation folds 0 to 4
- noise_free / noise_005 / noise_05: model noise sigma 0 / 0.05 / 0.5
- 010 / 020 after noise_005: measurement noise gamma 0.1 / 0.2
- flyvis_conductance: code name of the general-form GNN, g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j)
- flyvis_known_ode: code name of the Known-ODE model (the generator's equation with learned W, tau, V_rest)
- condl25 / condl100: group lasso 25 / 100 on g_phi's input groups
- null_edges_pc_400 / null400: 400% extra null edges added to the connectome
- removed_pc_20 / rm20, removed_pc_50 / rm50: 20% / 50% of the edges removed
- hidden_020 / hid20, hid10: 20% / 10% of the neurons hidden
- s5h06 / s5h21: one frame in five observed, rollout horizon 6 / 21
- INR_davis: stimulus not given, learned by a SIREN network
- full_eye_flywireRF / e8_flywireRF: FlyWire eye / e8 hybrid connectome; proximal_nulls: with proximal null edges
